scope: 144 pre-existing layer-boundary intervals, model49 main stream, complete-contained tasks only
limits: Each boundary interval is inferred from layer markers, not a verified Engram module; it may include other work.
Only selected model and main stream; unknown or nonpositive cycles omitted, overlapping records not deduplicated; incomplete captured work and counter rounding remain.
Positive cycle-weighted MAC proxy is not whole NPU utilization, throughput, idle or time; empty denominator is unknown, never zero.
Different groups or ranks need not contain identical workload/request; no causal inference or speedup.
Boundary crossing excluded and counted, cannot assume no relevant work.
